intent: Add a dedicated repository-local tests/e2e corpus for evopilot-harness, with reusable executable scenarios and version-bound manifests for v4.6.0, v4.7.0, and v4.8.0 that project authoritative Evolution Target acceptance contracts and reference immutable external evidence without duplicating authority.
objective: Make the already-governed v4.6.0 through v4.8.0 E2E contracts discoverable, mechanically verifiable, and reproducible from one repository-local entry point while preserving governance/targets as the sole acceptance authority and leaving released product semantics unchanged.

evidence.authority: user request to prepare and execute a governed change; not Target approval or Release authorization
released v4.8.0 cumulative acceptance baseline and existing RC01-RC05 source contract
read-only repository-structure audit evidence; grants no product authority

include: a dedicated tests/e2e directory with one documented repository-local entry point
a machine-readable manifest schema and fail-closed validator for version-bound E2E projections
version manifests for evopilot-harness 4.6.0, 4.7.0, and 4.8.0 bound to exact authoritative Target file digests and RC01-RC05 definitions
reusable scenario metadata, expected terminal states, prohibited effects, and evidence-reference requirements without copying authoritative acceptance prose into a second authority source
automated tests proving valid manifests pass and stale Target digests, unknown cases, incomplete coverage, unsafe paths, or authority duplication fail closed
documentation explaining the separation between executable E2E projections, authoritative Evolution Targets, and external immutable execution evidence
exclude: any change to Engine, CLI, MCP, Digital Expert, Agent adapter, Harness Asset, Catalog, Registry, Ontology, Policy, Evaluation, or publication behavior
any change to the released v4.6.0, v4.7.0, or v4.8.0 Evolution Targets or their acceptance status
copying private or large Host transcripts, credentials, Source contents, or mutable external evidence into the repository
retroactively invalidating an accepted or released version solely because its E2E corpus was previously distributed across governance, runner, and external evidence surfaces
new package publication, GitHub Release, npm release, version bump, product-boundary change, or Release authorization

acceptance.criterion: One repository-local command discovers and validates the dedicated tests/e2e corpus without requiring private external evidence to be copied into the checkout.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: passing automated invocation of the repository-local E2E validator and its test suite from the repository root

acceptance.criterion: The 4.6.0, 4.7.0, and 4.8.0 manifests bind exact authoritative Target file digests and project every declared RC01-RC05 case without inventing or dropping a case.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: validator output proving exact Target digest, version, case-id, and coverage agreement for all three manifests

acceptance.criterion: Reusable scenario metadata and runner contracts are shared without duplicating version-specific authoritative acceptance semantics.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: structural tests and documentation-link validation showing manifests reference shared schemas or runners and authoritative Target locations

acceptance.criterion: Target digest drift, unsupported versions, missing or reordered RC cases, unsafe evidence references, incomplete mappings, and authority duplication fail closed with deterministic diagnostics.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: negative automated cases covering each declared fail-closed condition

acceptance.criterion: governance/targets remains the sole authority for acceptance meaning and status; tests/e2e is an executable projection and cannot approve, validate, release, or rewrite a Target.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: schema, validator, architecture guard, and documentation checks proving one-way read-only projection

acceptance.criterion: A contributor can locate version coverage, run validation, and identify the authoritative Target and evidence references from tests/e2e without reconstructing the prior release conversation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: repository-local README, manifest index, command transcript, and documentation-link validation

acceptance.criterion: External execution evidence remains referenced by immutable locator and digest, while secrets, private transcripts, mutable state, and large raw artifacts remain outside the repository.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: positive and negative validator tests for evidence reference shape and prohibited embedded evidence fields

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: The released evopilot-harness 4.8.0 Target, its cumulative acceptance closure, and its authority boundaries remain unchanged while repository-local E2E projections are added.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: unchanged authoritative Target digest, passing Roadmap and architecture gates, full existing test suite, and package-content comparison showing no released product surface change

regressionImpact.area: repository E2E projection, governance validation, documentation routing, and package-boundary safety

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A fresh checkout validates the v4.6.0 E2E manifest against its exact released Target and enumerates RC01-RC05 in authoritative order.
realCaseCoverage.startingState: clean checkout with repository dependencies available and no private acceptance workspace mounted
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: v4.6.0 manifest validation passes and reports the exact Target digest and five projected case ids
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: machine-readable validator result plus node:test coverage for the v4.6.0 projection

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Tampered fixtures exercise digest drift, unsupported version, incomplete or reordered RC coverage, unsafe evidence references, and embedded-authority attempts.
realCaseCoverage.startingState: isolated temporary copies of valid manifests with one controlled defect per fixture
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: every invalid fixture fails closed with its deterministic diagnostic and no repository or external mutation
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: negative node:test matrix and machine-readable failure classifications

realCaseCoverage.scenario: The aggregate repository-local E2E command validates all supported versions, documentation links, authority separation, and package-boundary safety in one deterministic run.
realCaseCoverage.startingState: fresh repository checkout using only checked-in files and ordinary local Node tooling
realCaseCoverage.terminalState: all version projections and negative tests pass, the released Target files remain byte-identical, and npm package contents exclude repository-only E2E governance assets
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: aggregate command transcript, full repository validation, unchanged Target digests, and npm package-content verification
